title: Hoping to unseat Collins, Maine Democrats battle it out in an expensive US Senate primary
summary: As June's primary election nears, Democratic Gov. Janet Mills and combat veteran Graham Platner are effectively engaged in a proxy battle between factions in their own party.
contentText:
